title: Lookout Point Lakeside Inn
specs: Rated No. 2 Best Small & Boutique Hotel in the U.S. and No. 22 in the World by Tripadvisor
Rated No. 3 Best Pet-Friendly Hotel in the U.S. and No. 15 in the World by Tripadvisor
Located on Lake Hamilton with 200 ft of shoreline and lake access
Complimentary use of non-motorized water toys and swimming in lake
Guests must be 15 years or older; no children under 15 allowed
Maximum occupancy of 2 persons per room
Dogs allowed only in 3 designated rooms; must be sociable, vaccinated, flea/tick prevented, and housebroken
Dogs must be crated if left alone in room; barking dogs require immediate guest return
Maximum 3 rooms or 6 guests per group; no exceptions
